source: Guided assistant teaching texts (scripts/extract_guide_strings.py); key = Chinese text in guides/*_guide.dart, {name} = value from the page or guide

strings.{said}。號碼還沒打好喔，先按「確認」關掉，再把帳單上的號碼打進框框。: {said}. The number is not filled in yet. Tap "{page:確認}" to close it, then type the number from your bill into the box.
strings.{said}。先按「確認」關掉，再檢查一下號碼有沒有打錯、有沒有多打空白。: {said}. Tap "{page:確認}" to close it, then check the number for typos or extra spaces.
strings.中間的符號也要打。: Type the symbols in between too.
strings.點一下框框，照這個樣子打：「{sample}」，{dash}: Tap the box and type it like this: "{sample}". {dash}
strings.點一下「{name}」的框框，照這個樣子打：「{sample}」，{dash}: Tap the "{name}" box and type it like this: "{sample}". {dash}
strings.點一下亮起來的框框，照帳單上的號碼打進去。: Tap the highlighted box and type the number from your bill.
strings.點一下框框，打上帳單上的「{name}」。: Tap the box and type the "{name}" from your bill.
strings.在繳費項目清單點要繳的費用，例如水費: In the list of payment types, tap the one you want to pay, for example the water bill
strings.費用選好了！接下來輸入帳單上的號碼。: Payment type chosen! Next, enter the number from your bill.
strings.照畫面上的欄位，把帳單上的號碼打進去，再按「查詢」。: Type the number from your bill into the fields on the screen, then tap "{page:查詢}".
strings.點你要繳的那一項，例如「水費」或「停車費」。: Tap the one you want to pay, for example "{page:水費}" or "{page:停車費}".
strings.你要繳哪一種費用？先點一個大類打開來看，例如「規費」。: What would you like to pay? First tap a group to open it, for example "{page:規費}".
strings.在清單點你要繳的費用。找不到可以按上面的搜尋框打名稱。: Tap what you want to pay in the list. Can't find it? Tap the search box at the top and type its name.
strings.把帳單上的號碼（例如水號）打進框框: Type the number from your bill (for example the water account number) into the box
strings.號碼打好了！按「查詢」就能看到要繳的帳單。: Number entered! Tap "{page:查詢}" to see the bills to pay.
strings.按下面的「查詢」，看看要繳多少錢。: Tap "{page:查詢}" below to see how much to pay.
strings.這裡是用相機掃描的。點上面的「{tab}」，改用打字的。: This tab uses the camera to scan. Tap "{tab}" at the top to type it in instead.
strings.{where}印在帳單上。點一下亮起來的框框，照帳單打進去。: {where} is printed on your bill. Tap the highlighted box and type it as shown on the bill.
strings.{where}印在帳單上（{hint}）。點一下亮起來的框框，照帳單打進去。: {where} is printed on your bill ({hint}). Tap the highlighted box and type it as shown on the bill.
strings.按「查詢」找帳單: Tap "{page:查詢}" to find the bill
strings.號碼打好後按「查詢」，看要繳的帳單和金額: After typing the number, tap "{page:查詢}" to see the bills and amounts
strings.查到了！這些是要繳的帳單。: Found them! These are the bills to pay.
strings.在帳單右邊的小方框打勾，就是要繳這一張。: Tick the small box on the right of a bill to pay that one.
strings.打好了！按下面的「查詢」，看看{fee}要繳多少錢。: All typed! Tap "{page:查詢}" below to see how much {fee} is.
strings.按畫面最下面的「查詢」。: Tap "{page:查詢}" at the very bottom of the screen.
strings.在查到的帳單右邊打勾，選要繳哪幾張: Tick the box on the right of each bill you want to pay
strings.按下面的「前往繳費」，選付款方式。: Tap "{page:前往繳費}" below to choose how to pay.
strings.這次沒有查到要繳的帳單。按左上角的「‹」回上一頁，檢查號碼再查一次。: No bills were found this time. Tap "‹" at the top left to go back, check the number and try again.
strings.查到 1 張帳單！看一下繳費期限和金額，點右邊的小方框打勾。: Found 1 bill! Check the due date and amount, then tick the small box on the right.
strings.查到 {n} 張帳單。上下滑動看看，在要繳的帳單右邊打勾；全部都要繳，可以按「全: Found {n} bills. Scroll up and down, and tick the box on the right of the ones to pay. To pay them all, tap "{page:全部繳清}".
strings.在帳單右邊的小方框打勾。沒有帳單的話，回上一頁檢查號碼。: Tick the small box on the right of the bill. If there are no bills, go back and check the number.
strings.看一下總金額，按「前往繳費」: Check the total, then tap "{page:前往繳費}"
strings.到付款頁了！選一個付款方式。: This is the payment page! Choose a payment method.
strings.在「請選擇繳費方式」點一個你常用的付款方式。: Under "{page:請選擇繳費方式}", tap the payment method you usually use.
strings.選好了！總金額是 {total}。按下面的「前往繳費」。: Done! The total is {total}. Tap "{page:前往繳費}" below.
strings.按畫面最下面的「前往繳費」。: Tap "{page:前往繳費}" at the very bottom of the screen.
strings.在「請選擇繳費方式」點一個常用的付款方式: Under "{page:請選擇繳費方式}", tap a payment method you usually use
strings.看一下提醒，沒問題就自己按「是」。: Read the reminder. If everything is right, tap "{page:是}" yourself.
strings.選一個你平常用的付款方式，例如「悠遊付」。下面還有，可以往下滑看看。: Choose the payment method you usually use, for example "{page:悠遊付}". There are more below, so you can scroll down.
strings.選一個你平常用的付款方式，例如「悠遊付」。: Choose the payment method you usually use, for example "{page:悠遊付}".
strings.看清楚費用和金額，再自己按「是」: Check the payment and amount, then tap "{page:是}" yourself
strings.繳好了！這是示範網站，沒有真的扣款喔。: Paid! This is a demo site, so no money was really taken.
strings.繳好了。這是示範網站，沒有真的扣款。: Paid. This is a demo site, so no money was really taken.
strings.繳好了！畫面寫「繳費完成」。這是示範網站，沒有真的扣款喔。: Paid! The screen says "{page:繳費完成}". This is a demo site, so no money was really taken.
strings.繳好了！用「{method}」繳了 {amount}。這是示範網站，沒有真的扣款: Paid! You paid {amount} with "{method}". This is a demo site, so no money was really taken.
strings.最後確認一下：要繳的是{what}。畫面提醒要在 10 分鐘內付完。沒問題就自己: One last check: you are paying {what}. The screen reminds you to finish within 10 minutes. If that is right, tap "{page:是}" yourself. This is a demo site, so no money will be taken.
strings.看一下費用和金額對不對，沒問題就自己按「是」；不想繳就按「否」。: Check that the payment and amount are right. If so, tap "{page:是}" yourself; if you don't want to pay, tap "{page:否}".
strings.在繳費紀錄用上面的選單挑時間、費用或狀態: In payment history, use the menus at the top to choose a period, payment type or status
strings.篩選好了！下面就是符合的繳費紀錄。: Filtered! The matching payments are below.
strings.想看別的，再點上面的選單換一個。: To see something else, tap a menu at the top and pick another option.
strings.這個條件下沒有繳費紀錄。可以換一個時間或費用再看看。: There are no payments for this choice. Try another period or payment type.
strings.這是你的繳費紀錄，目前是空的。想看更早的，點左邊的「近1年」改成「近3年」。: This is your payment history. It is empty for now. To see older ones, tap "{page:近1年}" on the left and change it to "{page:近3年}".
strings.這是你的繳費紀錄。想只看一種費用，點中間的「所有項目」選一個。: This is your payment history. To see only one payment type, tap "{page:所有項目}" in the middle and pick one.
strings.左邊選時間，中間選費用，右邊選成功或失敗。: Left: choose the period. Middle: the payment type. Right: successful or failed.
strings.可以繳水費、停車費、學雜費等費用：先輸入帳單上的號碼查帳單，勾選要繳的，再選付款: You can pay water bills, parking fees, school fees and more: enter the number from your bill to look it up, tick what to pay, then choose a payment method. You can also see your payment history.
strings.好的！已經幫你打開繳費頁面，我會在畫面上一步一步帶你做。: OK! I opened the payment page for you. I will guide you step by step on the screen.
strings.好的！繳費頁面打開了，我們一起來{taskTitle}。: OK! The payment page is open. Let's do this together: {taskTitle}.
strings.我要繳水費: I want to pay my water bill
strings.好的！已經幫你打開繳費頁面。我們先用帳單上的號碼查帳單，再選付款方式，最後由你自: OK! I opened the payment page for you. First we look up your bill with the number on it, then choose how to pay, and at the end you confirm the payment yourself. I will guide you step by step on the screen.
strings.好的！繳費頁面打開了，我們先查帳單吧。: OK! The payment page is open. Let's look up your bill first.
strings.什麼是水號？: What is a water account number?
strings.這本書不能預約喔，頁面上寫「本館藏不提供預約」。按左上角的「‹」回上一頁，換一本: This book cannot be reserved. The page says "{page:本館藏不提供預約}". Tap "‹" at the top left to go back, and try another book.
strings.在館藏查詢點「關鍵字搜尋」: In "{page:館藏查詢}", tap "{page:關鍵字搜尋}"
strings.搜尋頁打開了！在上面的框打書名就可以找書。: The search page is open! Type a book title in the box at the top to find books.
strings.在搜尋框打書名或作者，再按右邊的放大鏡。: Type a title or author in the search box, then tap the magnifier on the right.
strings.先點一下上面的「館藏查詢」。: First, tap "{page:館藏查詢}" at the top.
strings.我們先找書！點一下上面的「關鍵字搜尋」。: Let's find a book first! Tap "{page:關鍵字搜尋}" at the top.
strings.先點一下上面的「關鍵字搜尋」。: First, tap "{page:關鍵字搜尋}" at the top.
strings.在搜尋框打書名或作者，再按放大鏡: Type a title or author in the search box, then tap the magnifier
strings.找到書了！點書名就能看詳細內容。: Books found! Tap a title to see the details.
strings.在搜尋結果點書名，可以看這本書的詳細內容。: Tap a title in the results to see the details of that book.
strings.點一下框框，打你想找的書名，例如「神奇柑仔店」。: Tap the box and type the title you want, for example "{page:神奇柑仔店}".
strings.打好了嗎？按右邊的放大鏡搜尋。: Done typing? Tap the magnifier on the right to search.
strings.點一下搜尋框，打書名或作者，打好按右邊的放大鏡。: Tap the search box, type a title or author, then tap the magnifier on the right.
strings.不知道要找什麼時，點一個熱門關鍵字: Not sure what to look for? Tap a popular keyword
strings.這些是大家常找的書！點書名就能看詳細內容。: These are books many people look for! Tap a title to see the details.
strings.不知道要找什麼嗎？點一個下面的「熱門關鍵字」看看。: Not sure what to look for? Tap one of the "{page:熱門關鍵字}" below.
strings.「熱門關鍵字」是大家常找的字，點一個就會幫你搜尋。: "{page:熱門關鍵字}" are words many people search for. Tap one and it searches for you.
strings.在搜尋結果點書名，看這本書的詳細內容: Tap a title in the results to see that book's details
strings.這頁有書的介紹和館藏。想借的話，在下面選取書館再預約。: This page shows the book's description and which libraries have it. To borrow it, choose a pickup library below, then reserve.
strings.找到了！上下滑動看看，想借哪一本，點一下書名就好。: Found them! Scroll up and down, and tap the title of the book you want.
strings.這次沒有找到書。換個書名，在上面的框重新打字搜尋。: No books found this time. Try another title in the box at the top.
strings.在搜尋結果點你想借的那本書。: In the results, tap the book you want to borrow.
strings.選要去哪一間圖書館拿書: Choose which library you will pick the book up at
strings.取書館就是你要去拿書的圖書館。: The pickup library is the library where you will collect the book.
strings.接下來，點這裡選要去哪間圖書館拿書。: Next, tap here to choose which library you will pick the book up at.
strings.點一下你方便去拿書的圖書館。: Tap a library that is easy for you to get to.
strings.選好了！按右上角的「✕」關掉這個視窗。: Done! Tap "✕" at the top right to close this window.
strings.這本書的館藏不提供預約。按左上角的「‹」回到搜尋結果，選另一本書。: This book cannot be reserved. Tap "‹" at the top left to go back to the results and pick another book.
strings.點「請選擇取書館」，選一個你方便去拿書的圖書館，再按右上角的「✕」。: Tap "{page:請選擇取書館}", choose a library that is easy for you to get to, then tap "✕" at the top right.
strings.看清楚書名和取書館，再自己按「預約」: Check the title and pickup library, then tap "{page:預約}" yourself
strings.預約好了！這是示範網站，沒有真的送出喔。: Reserved! This is a demo site, so nothing was really sent.
strings.預約好了。等圖書館通知書到了，再去你選的取書館把書借回家。: Reserved. When the library tells you the book has arrived, go to your pickup library and borrow it.
strings.等通知，到館取書: Wait for the notice, then pick up the book
strings.這次沒有預約成功，畫面上有寫原因。可以按「查看預約清單」看看，或換一本書。: The reservation did not go through. The reason is on the screen. You can tap "{page:查看預約清單}", or try another book.
strings.這次沒有預約成功，原因是「{reason}」。可以按「查看預約清單」看看，或換一: The reservation did not go through. The reason: "{reason}". You can tap "{page:查看預約清單}", or try another book.
strings.最後確認一下：預約{what}，在{where}拿書。沒問題就自己按「預約」喔。: One last check: you are reserving {what}, to pick up at {where}. If that is right, tap "{page:預約}" yourself.
strings.看一下書名和取書館對不對，沒問題就自己按「預約」。: Check that the title and pickup library are right. If so, tap "{page:預約}" yourself.
strings.打開點閱排行的「更多」，看大家最常看的書: Open "{page:更多}" next to "{page:點閱排行}" to see the books people view most
strings.這是點閱排行，越前面越多人看！點書名可以看詳細內容。: This is the most-viewed list. The higher up, the more people viewed it! Tap a title to see the details.
strings.點閱排行是大家最常看的書，點書名就能看詳細內容。: The most-viewed list shows the books people view most. Tap a title to see the details.
strings.點一下「點閱排行」右邊的「更多」。: Tap "{page:更多}" to the right of "{page:點閱排行}".
strings.往下滑一點，找到「點閱排行」。: Scroll down a little to find "{page:點閱排行}".
strings.在館藏查詢往下滑，點「點閱排行」右邊的「更多」。: In "{page:館藏查詢}", scroll down and tap "{page:更多}" to the right of "{page:點閱排行}".
strings.打開重要訊息的「更多」，看圖書館的公告: Open "{page:更多}" next to "{page:重要訊息}" to see the library's notices
strings.這些是圖書館的公告，休館或活動的消息都在這裡。: These are the library's notices. News about closures and events is all here.
strings.點公告的標題，可以看完整的內容。: Tap a notice title to read all of it.
strings.點一下「重要訊息」右邊的「更多」。: Tap "{page:更多}" to the right of "{page:重要訊息}".
strings.往下滑到最下面，找到「重要訊息」。: Scroll all the way down to find "{page:重要訊息}".
strings.在館藏查詢滑到最下面，點「重要訊息」右邊的「更多」。: In "{page:館藏查詢}", scroll to the bottom and tap "{page:更多}" to the right of "{page:重要訊息}".
strings.點上面的「我的紀錄」，看預約和借閱: Tap "{page:我的紀錄}" at the top to see your reservations and loans
strings.這是你的紀錄！預約、可取書、借閱中都在這裡。: These are your records! Reservations, books ready for pickup and current loans are all here.
strings.點每一行可以打開來看是哪幾本書。: Tap each line to open it and see which books it has.
strings.點一下上面的「我的紀錄」。: Tap "{page:我的紀錄}" at the top.
strings.點畫面上方的「我的紀錄」。: Tap "{page:我的紀錄}" at the top of the screen.
strings.在我的紀錄點「可取書」，看哪本書可以去拿: In "{page:我的紀錄}", tap "{page:可取書}" to see which books you can pick up
strings.這些書可以去拿了！看一下「取書館」和「取書期限」，記得在期限前去拿喔。: These books are ready! Check the "{page:取書館}" and "{page:取書期限}", and pick them up before the deadline.
strings.可取書會寫取書館和取書期限，帶著借書證在期限前去拿。: Books ready for pickup show the pickup library and the deadline. Bring your library card and pick them up in time.
strings.點一下「可取書」，看看哪本書可以去拿了。: Tap "{page:可取書}" to see which books you can pick up now.
strings.在我的紀錄點「可取書」那一行。: In "{page:我的紀錄}", tap the "{page:可取書}" line.
strings.點上面的「分館地圖」，找附近的圖書館: Tap "{page:分館地圖}" at the top to find libraries nearby
strings.這是分館地圖！允許使用位置，就能看到離你最近的圖書館。: This is the library map! Allow location access to see the libraries closest to you.
strings.按「展開列表」可以看所有分館和距離。: Tap "{page:展開列表}" to see every branch and how far it is.
strings.點一下上面的「分館地圖」。: Tap "{page:分館地圖}" at the top.
strings.點畫面上方的「分館地圖」。: Tap "{page:分館地圖}" at the top of the screen.
strings.可以搜尋圖書館有哪些書，選好書再預約，之後到圖書館取書。也可以看排行、公告、我的: You can search the library's books, choose one and reserve it, then pick it up at the library. You can also see the rankings, notices, your records and the library map.
strings.好的！已經幫你打開圖書館服務。我們先找到書、預約，之後再到圖書館取書。我會在畫面: OK! I opened the library service for you. First we find a book and reserve it; later you pick it up at the library. I will guide you step by step on the screen.
strings.好的！已經幫你打開圖書館服務，我會在畫面上一步一步帶你做。: OK! I opened the library service for you. I will guide you step by step on the screen.
strings.好的！圖書館服務打開了，我們一起找書吧。: OK! The library service is open. Let's find a book together.
strings.好的！圖書館服務打開了，我們一起來{taskTitle}。: OK! The library service is open. Let's do this together: {taskTitle}.
strings.預約和借書一樣嗎？: Is reserving the same as borrowing?
strings.我要借書: I want to borrow a book
strings.好的！已經幫你打開「{pageName}」，我會在畫面上一步一步帶你做。: OK! I opened "{pageName}" for you. I will guide you step by step on the screen.
strings.好的！「{pageName}」打開了，我們一起來{taskTitle}。: OK! "{pageName}" is open. Let's do this together: {taskTitle}.
